3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: Lucian and I walked into my office in the Maroon Palace to make my Address to the Nation speech.

6.speaker: Narrator
6.text: It was unusually crowded today. Cameras, lights and microphones were set in place and the crew was standing by, ready to start filming.

9.speaker: Lucian Galade
9.text: "Good. I think the crew is ready. As soon as you take your seat, we can go live."

10.speaker: Lucian Galade
10.text: "I'm sure you are, sir. As soon as you take your seat, we can go live. The crew is ready."

11.speaker: Narrator
11.text: I took my seat and rearranged my notes on the desk as a crew member powdered my face with a cotton puff.

12.speaker: Narrator
12.text: After everybody was ready, the director gave the sign to start filming. I looked directly into the camera.

16.speaker: Player
16.text: "I am grateful to earn the honor of finally modifying the Constitution of Tarquin Soll."

17.speaker: Player
17.text: "I'd like to speak about our future, about a great historic effort to give the words 'freedom,' 'fairness,' and 'hope' new meaning and power."

18.speaker: Player
18.text: "I am happy to have this opportunity to talk to you about the changes we have undertaken in Sordland."

19.speaker: Player
19.text: "We have reached a turning point in Sordland's history."

20.speaker: Player
20.text: "I am proud of what our government has accomplished. We have finally brought fairness and balance to our once-decrepit system."

21.speaker: Player
21.text: "Two years ago, I spoke to you of change, and we have accomplished that."

22.speaker: Player
22.text: "We need to remember where Sordland was two years ago. Those days are behind us now, and the change we brought has been real."

23.speaker: Player
23.text: "But in another sense, our change is a continuation of that which started three decades ago with the fall of monarchy."

24.speaker: Player
24.text: "Our new Constitution is a second revolution in the history of Sordland that truly transforms the course of government with just one word: Democracy."

25.speaker: Player
25.text: "The new system brings a more transparent democracy that will help Sordland rise up in the world."

26.speaker: Player
26.text: "For the sake of fairness, simplicity, and growth, we had to radically change the structure of our government system."

27.speaker: Player
27.text: "We made a Constitution that no longer protects the rights of a select few elites, but ensures the participation of all."

28.speaker: Player
28.text: "We transformed a system that had caused endless confusion and resentment into one that is clear, simple, and fair for all."

29.speaker: Player
29.text: "We will not rest until every Sordish citizen enjoys the freedom, dignity, and opportunity that is our birthright."

30.speaker: Player
30.text: "With our reforms complete, our government will now focus on the economic development of Sordland."

31.speaker: Player
31.text: "Now, we have our next challenges. We will be focusing on Sordland's internal and external threats."

32.speaker: Narrator
32.text: I paused to take a deep breath.

36.speaker: Player
36.text: "Next, we must transition into the parliamentary system."

37.speaker: Player
37.text: "Henceforth, our government shall no longer be able to obstruct the will of the people."

38.speaker: Player
38.text: "I've spoken with and received letters from thousands of you. I know how hungry you were for change. Make no mistake. Together, we can change Sordland forever."

39.speaker: Player
39.text: "By now I'm sure you have one question on your minds: Will our reforms help you? You bet they will. We see them as the democratization of Sordland because they close loopholes that benefit a privileged few."

61.speaker: Player
61.text: "New term limits will ensure that no single person can block change when it's most needed."

62.speaker: Player
62.text: "We now ensure that neither I nor any other person who holds the position of president will pose the risk of ruling by decree."

63.speaker: Player
63.text: "We eliminated the Supreme Court's iron grip on our legislation."

65.speaker: Player
65.text: "I stand proud to have exchanged my own powers for a better future. Presidential decrees are now a thing of the past."

66.speaker: Player
66.text: "I will personally make sure that every change is respected and executed properly."

67.speaker: Player
67.text: "Beyond this, we intend to strengthen the democratic freedoms of every Sordish citizen."

68.speaker: Player
68.text: "I must thank the Supreme Court Justices for supporting these much-needed changes."

69.speaker: Player
69.text: "For too long, our Supreme Court has acted on behalf of sinister deep state interests. That ends from now on."

70.speaker: Player
70.text: "By abolishing the position of Member of Honor, we have ensured that Sordland will no longer be a slave to its past."

71.speaker: Player
71.text: "I promise you. We will not stop."

72.speaker: Player
72.text: "We have also lowered our unfair election threshold. No longer will the voices of the minority be silenced."

73.speaker: Player
73.text: "We did all of this in a time of economic stress and despite heavy protests."

74.speaker: Player
74.text: "Voices were raised saying that we had to look to our past for greatness and glory. We proved, and will continue to prove them wrong."

75.speaker: Player
75.text: "The new changes in our system have planted the seeds for untold future successes."

76.speaker: Player
76.text: "We will open the way for Tarquin Soll's trial. He must answer for the crimes committed during his decades-long rule."

77.speaker: Player
77.text: "We are creating a nation once again vibrant, robust, and alive."

78.speaker: Player
78.text: "But we, the present-day Sords, are not given to looking backward. In this blessed land, there is always a better tomorrow."

79.speaker: Player
79.text: "It is time to renew our faith in our system."

80.speaker: Player
80.text: "Fellow citizens of Sordland, let me assure you, our nation is poised for greatness."

81.speaker: Player
81.text: "Today, we must do what we know is right, and do it with all of our might."

82.speaker: Player
82.text: "Let history say of us: these were the golden years when Sordish Democracy was reborn, when Sordland reached for her best."

83.speaker: Player
83.text: "I'll remind you of the revolutionary phrase: 'Morning will come, Victory is close.' I am now glad to say that morning has finally come."

84.speaker: Player
84.text: "I will not let any of my fellow citizens down."

85.speaker: Player
85.text: "The United Sordland Party will keep fighting for a stronger and more united Sordland."

86.speaker: Player
86.text: "The future lies in the Socialist Movement of the East."

88.speaker: Player
88.text: "The future lies in the Democratic Movement of the West."

93.speaker: Player
93.text: "We must take lessons from the Malenyevist revolution in United Contana."

94.speaker: Player
94.text: "Sordland must slowly put more power in the hands of the working class, which capitalism formerly oppressed."

95.speaker: Player
95.text: "We must lead Sordland with democratic socialism."

96.speaker: Player
96.text: "We must take lessons from Arcasia's democracy."

97.speaker: Player
97.text: "We must keep striving for a fair and transparent democracy in Sordland and abroad."

98.speaker: Player
98.text: "We must lead Sordland with social democracy."

101.speaker: Narrator
101.text: I took another deep breath. Lucian shooed a fly away from my forehead.

102.speaker: Player
102.text: "For a Sordland of wisdom that honors the family, knowing that as the family goes, so goes our civilization."

103.speaker: Player
103.text: "For a Sordland of vision that sees tomorrow's dreams in the learning and hard work we do today."

104.speaker: Player
104.text: "For a Sordland of courage whose servicemen and -women, even as I speak, proudly stand watch on the frontiers of freedom."

105.speaker: Player
105.text: "Let us begin by challenging our conventional wisdom."

106.speaker: Player
106.text: "We have begun promisingly. But it's only a beginning."

107.speaker: Player
107.text: "We're not here to congratulate ourselves on what we have done, but to challenge ourselves to finish what has not yet been done."

112.speaker: Narrator
112.text: The director gave the cut signal, and the cameraman stopped filming. My speech was finished.

116.speaker: Player
116.text: "I'd like to speak about our future, about a great historic effort to give the words 'unity' and 'hope' new meaning and power."

123.speaker: Player
123.text: "The new system brings a stronger government that will help Sordland rise up in the world."

124.speaker: Player
124.text: "Our new Constitution is a second revolution in the history of Sordland that truly transforms the course of government with just one word: Power."

128.speaker: Player
128.text: "We made a Constitution that no longer protects the rights of a select few elites."

129.speaker: Player
129.text: "We transformed a system that had caused endless confusion and resentment into one that is clear, simple, and efficient."

136.speaker: Player
136.text: "By now I'm sure you have one question on your minds: Will our reforms help you? You bet they will. We see them as a strengthening of our system because they ensure efficiency and justice."

137.speaker: Player
137.text: "Henceforth, our government shall no longer be able to obstruct the will of the people -- nor the will of the President."

144.speaker: Player
144.text: "With my new powers as president, I will do whatever it takes to transform this nation into a global superpower."

148.speaker: Player
148.text: "Let history say of us: these were the golden years when Sordland was reborn and reached for her best."

152.speaker: Player
152.text: "The future lies in the capitalism of the West."

217.speaker: Player
217.text: "I soared to election on the winds of change. Change that was desperately sought and called for by you, the people of Sordland."

218.speaker: Player
218.text: "From the moment I was sworn in, I have done nothing but fight to achieve the change you demanded."

219.speaker: Player
219.text: "I took office with a plan. To dismantle Sordland's ancient government structure and replace it with one that met the needs of the modern country we are today."

223.speaker: Player
223.text: "I began my term with one goal: To transform Sordland into a modern democracy."

224.speaker: Player
224.text: "I began my term with one goal: To transform Sordland into a global force to be reckoned with."

225.speaker: Player
225.text: "However, due to circumstances beyond my control, my plans were thwarted."

226.speaker: Player
226.text: "Alas, my vision was too grand for the narrow scope of our current Supreme Court."

227.speaker: Player
227.text: "My ambition did not waver, even as forces within my own government conspired against me."

231.speaker: Player
231.text: "Alas, my vision was too grand for the narrow scope of our current Assembly."

235.speaker: Player
235.text: "The Justices could not conceive of a Sordland in which they weren't free to engage in corruption and bribery, knowing nobody could remove them from office."

239.speaker: Player
239.text: "The Assembly could not conceive of a Sordland in which minority voices were represented and amplified."

246.speaker: Player
246.text: "The Assembly could not conceive of a Sordland in which they had no power to remove a beloved President from office."

250.speaker: Player
250.text: "The Justices could not conceive of a Sordland in which they were unable to interfere in the constitutional amendment process."

251.speaker: Player
251.text: "If Assembly members had their way, Tarquin Soll's Constitution would last until the end of time."

252.speaker: Player
252.text: "If the Justices had their way, Tarquin Soll's Constitution would last until the end of time -- and so would Soll's presidency."

253.speaker: Player
253.text: "And so they spitefully acted against me, putting their own pettiness before the needs of this country."

254.speaker: Player
254.text: "They stubbornly clung to Sordland's past, knowing it would cost us the country's future."

255.speaker: Player
255.text: "And so they struck down my reforms -- with the help of Soll himself."

256.speaker: Player
256.text: "When I refused to play their dirty games, they banded together against me."

257.speaker: Player
257.text: "But I will tell you this: I am not done fighting for you."

258.speaker: Player
258.text: "People of Sordland, Anton Rayne will not let himself be so easily cowed."

259.speaker: Player
259.text: "They may have defeated me, but they will never defeat the Sordish spirit!"

260.speaker: Player
260.text: "Historians shall look upon this as but a minor hurdle in Sordland's path to greatness."

261.speaker: Player
261.text: "It is time to put this setback behind us and focus on the challenges ahead."

262.speaker: Player
262.text: "I have not given up on my commitment to equality and justice."

266.speaker: Player
266.text: "I have not given up on my commitment to restore Sordland to glory."

267.speaker: Player
267.text: "Sordland must slowly put more power in the hands of the working class, which capitalism formerly oppressed."

269.speaker: Player
269.text: "The future lies in the Socialist Movement of the East."

270.speaker: Player

285.speaker: Player

286.speaker: Player
286.text: "We must keep striving for a fair and transparent democracy in Sordland and abroad."

288.speaker: Player
288.text: "The future lies in the capitalism of the West."

291.speaker: Player
291.text: "We must take lessons from the Malenyevist revolution in United Contana."

295.speaker: Player
295.text: "We must lead Sordland with democratic socialism."

296.speaker: Player
296.text: "The future lies in the Democratic Movement of the West."

307.speaker: Player
307.text: "And with our new allies in the PFJP, there is no end to what we can achieve."

308.speaker: Player
308.text: "And with our new allies in the NFP, there is no end to what we can achieve."

309.speaker: Player
309.text: "With or without the Assembly's support, there is no end to what we can achieve."

310.speaker: Player
310.text: "And with the Supreme Court on our side, there is no end to what we can achieve."

324.speaker: Player

325.speaker: Player

376.speaker: Player
376.text: "I soared to election on the winds of change. Change that was desperately sought and called for by you, the people of Sordland."

377.speaker: Player
377.text: "I took office with a plan. To lead Sordland out of recession and into greatness."

378.speaker: Player
378.text: "When I took office, I hoped to lead Sordland into a new era of peace and prosperity."

379.speaker: Player
379.text: "But I was forced to lay aside my aspirations as the country faced an unprecedented emergency."

380.speaker: Player
380.text: "But you know what they say about the best laid plans."

381.speaker: Player
381.text: "But before I could change Sordland, Sordland itself changed drastically."

382.speaker: Player
382.text: "My inauguration was marked by a brutal assassination."

383.speaker: Player
383.text: "Even as I was sworn in, tensions skyrocketed between the Red Youth and Young Sords."

384.speaker: Player
384.text: "No sooner was I inaugurated than the threat of Bludish separatism raised its head."

385.speaker: Player
385.text: "Extraordinary times called for extraordinary measures. But my opponents couldn't see that."

386.speaker: Player
386.text: "My calls for unity during this time of strife went unanswered by my opponents."

387.speaker: Player
387.text: "Even worse than the bloodshed were my opponents' attempts to use it to tear me down."

388.speaker: Player
388.text: "Yet I stand before you today, stronger than ever!"

392.speaker: Player
392.text: "Their court defeat is proof that our current state of emergency is more than justified."

396.speaker: Player
396.text: "They let themselves become blinded by hatred, attacking me even after I revoked Sordland's state of emergency."

397.speaker: Player
397.text: "I was attacked by the opposition on one side, and the Supreme Court on the other. I couldn't win."

398.speaker: Player
398.text: "The opposition and the Supreme Court teamed up to remove my powers at the exact time they were most needed."

399.speaker: Player
399.text: "I do not take my new power lightly. Every order I give is for the sake of the country."

400.speaker: Player
400.text: "I know you are counting on me to restore law and order to Sordland. And I will do so with all my might."

401.speaker: Player
401.text: "I know you were counting on me to restore law and order to Sordland. And I still plan to do so."

402.speaker: Player
402.text: "Having vanquished my enemies within the government, I shall now turn my attention to our *real* foes."

403.speaker: Player
403.text: "This infighting is a needless distraction from the real threats still raging within our borders."

404.speaker: Player
404.text: "All this infighting is blocking me from accomplishing the original goals I had set as your President."

414.speaker: Player
414.text: "I alone can eradicate the threat of Bludish separatism!"

415.speaker: Player
415.text: "I alone can eradicate the threat of violent nationalism!"

416.speaker: Player
416.text: "I alone can eradicate the communist scourge!"

417.speaker: Player
417.text: "As God is my witness, I will protect Sordland from those who seek to destroy it from within!"

418.speaker: Player
418.text: "There are those who seek to tear Sordland apart from within -- but together, we will beat them!"

419.speaker: Player
419.text: "I will defend Sordland against our enemies abroad!"
